creator: bengusberg
title: Pitch for skills.sh, a free directory of ~1.5M agent skills (Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor etc.) installed with 'npx skills add <owner/repo>'

tools.name: skills.sh
tools.detail: URL bar shows skills.sh; 'All Time (1,536,509)' install counter; 'AVAILABLE FOR THESE AGENTS' row of agent icons

tools.name: skills CLI

tools.name: Claude

claims: The site is free and has 'almost 1.5 million skills' (screen counter reads 1,536,509 all-time, which is more likely installs/leaderboard count than distinct skills)
Skills work in Claude, ChatGPT 'or wherever you AI'
Categories named: video generation, social media manager, sales and cold email outreach
Creator says he is a Stanford founder of an AI startup that raised $4M
how_to_steps: Click the skill you want (e.g. a 'social media manager' skill from the leaderboard list)
Drop it into Claude or ChatGPT and ask the model to help you install it (or run `npx skills add <owner/repo>` as shown on screen)
Try it and share what you build
on_screen_only: `$ npx skills add <owner/repo>` under a 'TRY IT NOW' header
'AVAILABLE FOR THESE AGENTS' with ~6 agent logos (Claude, OpenAI/Codex, Cursor and others)
Leaderboard-style list of 'social media manager' skills with install counts
cta: Follow for more on AI founder life and leadership; 'let me know what you build'

relevance.why: skills.sh is the same registry Haji already saw via Vercel's find-skills and the skills CLI; useful as a reminder of the npx install syntax but nothing new for someone already running Claude Code skills

implement_score.why: Already covered: Haji's workflow can use `npx skills add` today. The '1.5M skills' figure is inflated and most entries are low quality; the only action is to search skills.sh when a specific need arises rather than browse

verify: Is 1,536,509 the count of distinct skills or of installs? The screen label 'All Time' suggests installs/leaderboard
Quality/safety of random community skills from skills.sh (prompt-injection risk when installing unvetted SKILL.md files)
Creator's $4M-raised claim and the startup name are not shown

gap.what: duplicate of liked content (Vercel find-skills / skills.sh already covered); only adds the explicit `npx skills add <owner/repo>` command
